# Q&A Artifact Requirements

The clarification workflow should normally produce three artifacts.

## 1. Markdown Question Set

Purpose:

- make the full question set readable and reviewable
- preserve original numbering and structure
- create a stable review surface before analysis starts

Minimum sections:

- source metadata if known
- section headings from the original form
- question list in original order
- extraction notes for any missing or ambiguous source text

## 2. Analysis Report

Purpose:

- classify the questions
- separate client misunderstandings from legitimate clarification needs
- provide response guidance that is stronger than a literal answer-only sheet

Minimum sections:

- summary of themes
- table or structured list of all questions
- high-priority decision items
- research-backed counterpoints where needed
- explicit out-of-scope list

## 3. Temporary Workboard Plan Or Mockup

Purpose:

- track the ongoing clarification cycle
- support selective answering and staged response drafting
- keep the workflow exportable to HTML and PDF

Minimum sections:

- board lanes
- data model or JSON shape
- HTML/PDF output approach
- statement that the board is not part of production index or onboarding surfaces
